q: Does the write path see raw conversation, or a filtered subset?
a: raw. extract_facts (10:277) concatenates every message, both roles, into one blob and hands it to the LLM.

q: Is anything excluded at extraction time?
a: only by prompt instruction, and only for form, not category.

q: Extraction — one LLM call per turn, or batched?
a: per exchange, synchronously, inline with the response.

q: Does extraction have an "extracted nothing" path?
a: yes, explicitly.

q: Confidence — a scalar, or a categorical epistemic status?
a: a scalar, everywhere.

q: Is there any bi-temporal modelling?
a: yes, in exactly one notebook.

q: On dedupe, does the old record survive?
a: yes in technique 10, no in technique 14.

q: Does deletion actually delete?
a: technique 30 is the only one that tries, and it's thorough about breadth: delete_user (30:1174) hits hot, warm, cold, and graph tiers and writes four

q: How is a contradiction detected?
a: two-stage, similarity-gated.

q: Who wins?
a: recency, by default, in both places.

q: Is retrieval separable from disclosure?
a: no. Nowhere in the repo.

q: Is diversity or redundancy managed at read time?
a: only in technique 20, and only as a menu.

q: What does the system do when it doesn't know?
a: nothing. There is no abstention path in the repo.

q: Decay by wall-clock age, or by idle time since last use?
a: idle time.

q: Does retrieval reinforce?
a: yes, and unconditionally.

q: Are some memories exempt from decay?
a: no, and admitted.

q: Does storage pressure change the forgetting policy?
a: yes — apply_storage_pressure (19:364) mutates self.prune_threshold from 0.1 up to 0.5 as utilisation goes 80%→100%.

q: Is re-processing the same transcript idempotent?
a: no, and this is the least-examined assumption in the repo.

q: Does write order matter?
a: yes, unavoidably, and it's never mentioned.

q: One memory type, or several?
a: Two answers coexist in the repo, uncombined.

q: Similarity alone, or blended with something?
a: Three different answers, none reconciled

q: What happens when a component fails?
a: Three different answers, all quiet

q: Is there any concurrency story?
a: No. Every store is a Python list or dict mutated in place (10:238, 19:279, 30:219).
